notes: Sources + cosmetics + misc leftovers. Uses the shared roots source, misc, skilling, construction and crafting as parents without redefining them. Boss, raid, slayer and minigame lists come from the wiki Collection log page (matched to GE items by name/wikiTitle), plus items assembled directly from those drops (godswords, Torva, spirit shields, Cerberus boots, toxic blowpipe...). They are written as exact-name nameRegex alternations, because the per-boss wiki categories are noisy (e.g. 'Zulrah' includes anti-venom, 'Theatre of Blood' includes raid potions, 'Nightmare Zone' includes runes). A parent tag with its own match directly holds items shared between several children or from content too small for its own tag: boss-drop holds Dragon pickaxe/2h/chainbody and small-boss uniques, gwd-drop holds godsword shards, minigame-reward holds small minigames. Some items purposely get two sibling tags when two sources drop them (Staff of light: Zilyana + K'ril; Dragon axe: Dagannoth Kings + Wintertodt; Toxic staff: K'ril + Zulrah). shop-item is an ids list (~1000) built from the wiki 'storeline' bucket (shops that take coins only), so it should be regenerated rather than hand-edited. Bucket query used: bucket('storeline').select('sold_item','page_name','store_currency'). Added a sailing tag under skilling (with boat-part and boat-paint), since Sailing is not in the shared skill list. flatpack and bagged-plant are parented to construction, and fremennik-component to crafting; drop them if the production domain already covers them. Left out: pets (none on the GE), release year / noteable / stackable / generic monster drops, Nightmare Zone and Tokkul shop stock (common runes and ores, which would mislabel), Pest Control, Mahogany Homes, Castle Wars and Wintertodt outfit rewards (untradeable, not on the GE).
